executionHistory.summary: Authored the eight artifacts of this packet after committing the repository binding preflight for research-lab. Captured three distinct defects as three separate scopes: ingestion writing an adjusted close beside a raw low so that 71714 of 150161 rows across 245 of 293 bars files carry l > min(o, c); a committed fixture pinned to a fixed cutoff that resolves against mutable data the cron rewrites; and a boot error path whose catch never assigns state.view, so a data break presents as an unbounded hang instead of the refusal the page has already computed. Recorded in design.md that retroactively rewriting an already-published row is a provenance concern independent of the arithmetic, and that mergeRows overwrites by timestamp with no trace. Recorded in report.md that a global Playwright timeout was considered and disproven by execution at 240000 ms, and that applying one would have masked this defect rather than fixed it. Modified nothing outside this packet: data/, tests/, scripts/, research-agenda-lab.html and the BUG-011 packet are untouched, and nothing was committed. Every measurement in report.md is attributed to prior execution in this session; the agent's own execution was read-only inspection confirming each cited line number, field name and call site, including that the five failing tool-experience tests are exactly the five calling openResearchAgenda with the reversal fixture while the three calling it without the fixture pass.
